format: html

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import Markdown

df = pd.read_csv("data/water_municipal.csv", dtype={"divipola": str, "dpto_code": str})
n_rows, n_cols = df.shape
```

One row is a municipality × zone (urban/rural) × year. The table has
`{python} f"{n_rows:,}"` rows and `{python} n_cols` columns, covering
`{python} df["divipola"].nunique()` DIVIPOLA codes from `{python} int(df["year"].min())`
to `{python} int(df["year"].max())`. IRCA throughout is the **utility-supplied
(prestadores) IRCA** from INS open data (datos.gov.co `nxt2-39c3`).

## Missing values by zone

```{python}
#| label: tbl-missing
#| tbl-cap: "Percentage of rows with a missing value, by column and zone (all years)."
miss = (df.drop(columns=["zone"]).isna().groupby(df["zone"]).mean().T * 100).round(1)
miss = miss[["urban", "rural"]]
miss.index.name = "column"
Markdown(miss.to_markdown())
```

## IRCA by risk band and zone

Bands from Resolución 2115 de 2007, art. 15: 0–5 no risk, 5.1–14 low, 14.1–35 medium,
35.1–80 high, 80.1–100 unfit.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-bands
#| tbl-cap: "Number of rows by utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA band and zone, 2010–2023."
bands = ["No risk", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Unfit"]
df["irca_band"] = pd.cut(df["irca"], [-0.001, 5, 14, 35, 80, 100], labels=bands)
counts = pd.crosstab(df["irca_band"].cat.add_categories("No IRCA").fillna("No IRCA"), df["zone"])
counts = counts.reindex(bands + ["No IRCA"])[["urban", "rural"]]
counts.index.name = "IRCA band"
Markdown(counts.to_markdown())
```

## Median IRCA by year and zone

```{python}
#| label: fig-median
#| fig-cap: "Median utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA by year and zone, 2010–2023 (rows with an IRCA value)."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of median IRCA by year for urban and rural zones; the rural line is far above the urban line in every year."
med = df.groupby(["year", "zone"])["irca"].median().unstack()[["urban", "rural"]]
ax = med.plot(marker="o", figsize=(7, 3.5))
ax.set_ylabel("Median IRCA (prestadores, 0–100)")
ax.set_xlabel("")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-median
#| tbl-cap: "Median utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA by year and zone."
Markdown(med.round(1).to_markdown())
```
